legal_concern: Use of weapons or methods that cannot be directed at specific military objectives or whose effects cannot be limited.
documentation_needed: Targeting file, weapon effects model, civilian presence data, alternatives considered.

legal_concern: Use of weapons calculated to cause injury beyond legitimate military purpose.
documentation_needed: Technical design, medical effects, treaty screening, review memoranda.

legal_concern: Use against hospitals, humanitarian operations, cultural property, or civilians.
documentation_needed: Object status analysis, warnings, intelligence reliability, proportionality assessment.

legal_concern: Severe, widespread, long-term, or otherwise unlawful environmental damage.
documentation_needed: Environmental effects assessment, alternatives, command approvals, mitigation.

legal_concern: Failure to prevent, suppress, or report unlawful weapons use by subordinates.
documentation_needed: Training, orders, knowledge evidence, disciplinary records, reporting chains.
